notes: The warehouse is now drop-off only: leave goods there and your couriers and collectors take them where they're needed.
Build the belt to the parts works first and you no longer need its input worker: that hire disappears.
The Kiosk line now bends round buildings and pads instead of standing in them.
Hunting missions have a ranger to hire, near the hopper flats, once you've hunted by hand.
Missions 6 to 60 were rebuilt for these changes.
